en.headline: Customs seizes HK$10.85 million illicit cigarettes in Kwai Chung raid
en.dek: Officers found about 2.41 million sticks in an industrial-building unit and arrested three men aged 32 to 36 who are now on bail pending further inquiries.
body: Hong Kong Customs officers on Tuesday raided a suspected storage unit for illicit cigarettes inside an industrial building in Kwai Chung, seizing about 2.41 million sticks with an estimated market value of HK$10.85 million and a duty potential of about HK$7.98 million.

Three men aged between 32 and 36, who described themselves as a removal worker, a driver and a courier, were arrested at the scene. They have been released on bail pending further investigation. Customs said it would continue to trace the source of the consignment and did not rule out further arrests.

The department reiterated that dealing in, possessing, selling or buying illicit cigarettes is an offence under the Dutiable Commodities Ordinance, carrying a maximum penalty of a HK$2 million fine and seven years’ imprisonment. The public may report suspected activity via the 24-hour hotline 182 8080.

zh.headline: 海關葵涌工廈破私煙倉 檢1085萬元貨拘3男
zh.dek: 關員在工業大廈單位檢獲約241萬支懷疑私煙，市值約1085萬元，應課稅值約798萬元；三名32至36歲男子被捕，已保釋候查。
body: 香港海關今日在葵涌一工業大廈搗破懷疑私煙貯存倉庫，檢獲約241萬支懷疑私煙，估計市值約1085萬元，應課稅值約798萬元。
關員當場拘捕三名年齡介乎32至36歲的男子，他們分別報稱搬運工人、司機及速遞員，現已保釋候查。海關表示會繼續追查貨源，不排除有更多人被捕。
海關重申，根據《應課稅品條例》，處理、管有、售賣或購買私煙均屬違法，一經定罪最高可被判罰款200萬元及監禁七年。市民可致電24小時熱線182 8080舉報。
